evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said bash-format found no shfmt binary. Are shfmt and shellcheck installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for shfmt and shellcheck. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /bash-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Probes both shfmt and shellcheck via Bash rather than assuming either
Does not run `apply`, a package manager, or any download
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/bash-format:check

The check failed. Just install shellcheck for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /bash-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Does not install shellcheck or shfmt itself
Names /bash-format:setup apply as the route for install guidance the user asked for
Does not claim shellcheck is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When both binaries resolve, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /bash-format:setup apply

evals.name: shfmt-absence-depends-on-editorconfig-opt-in
evals.prompt:
/bash-format:check

shfmt is missing, and this repo's .editorconfig only has a bare [*] section.
evals.expected_output: Reports the missing shfmt as INFO, not FAIL, because no shell section opts the repo into formatting, and installs nothing.
expectations: Treats the missing shfmt as INFO because a bare [*] section is not a shell opt-in
Still probes shellcheck and reports it separately
Installs nothing and stops after the table

evals.name: check-runs-its-own-probes-including-node
evals.prompt:
/bash-format:check

node is not on PATH here, though shellcheck and shfmt are installed.
evals.expected_output: Runs the jq, node, shellcheck and shfmt probes via Bash, since setup's pre-computed rows are not rendered when this skill reads the file, and reports a Node.js FAIL with the reason.
expectations: Runs the jq, node, shellcheck and shfmt probes via Bash instead of expecting pre-computed rows
Reports the missing node as FAIL because every hook launch goes through node hooks/exec-bash.mjs
Installs nothing and stops after the table
